subject: Fenwick discovery — recap, pilot decision items and access path
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom@fenwickanalytics.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up from today's discovery

Chloe / Ben —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Helpful conversation — a few salient points I want to lock in while they're fresh: 

- Primary pain: Our ingest pipeline produces variable-quality transcripts and metadata; we need consistent semantic search and routing for case classification.
- Goal for POC: Achieve >70% accuracy on intent classification for top-5 use cases and reduce average triage time by 40%.
- Data: We'll provide a redacted sample (10k records) and a mapping doc for metadata fields.
- Security: SOC2 and evidence of data residency are deal-breakers at scale; procurement will require standard questionnaires.

Two asks from us: 1) a short pilot scope doc we can present to stakeholders and 2) an access checklist so our infra team can provision ahead of kickoff. Could you send both by EOD tomorrow?

Tom
Tom Ellis
Head of Platform Insights
Fenwick Analytics
—
[Attachment: fenwick-mapping-v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom@fenwickanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery

Tom —

Appreciate the clear summary. Short recap + proposed pilot plan attached (see "pilot-access-checklist.xlsx" and a lightweight prompt set CSV). Highlights below: 

Scope (30-day POC):
- Ingest: Redwood will connect to a s3-compatible bucket and pull the redacted sample.
- Models: Run retrieval + rerank pipeline (embedding model: r-instruct-3b; reranker: r-rerank-1) and a lightweight intent classifier for the 5 priority intents.
- Prompts/evals: We will run a 300-sample prompt-eval suite (attached) across the 5 intents and report precision/recall and a confusion matrix.

Success metrics (pass/fail gating):
- Intent classification precision >= 0.70 on the prioritized set.
- Mean first-token latency (for 256-token seq) < 250ms on Dedicated dev pool.
- E2E triage throughput to support 50 concurrent UI users.

Owners & timeline:
- Redwood owner: Chloe Martin (POC lead) — scheduling, model config, evals.
- Sales exec: Ben Carter — procurement and commercial.
- Fenwick owners: Tom Ellis (product), + infra (cc procurement).
- Kickoff target: next Monday 2026-09-20. Provisioning window: 3 business days.

Access/setup asks (short):
1) S3 read-only IAM user (temporary) or agreed presigned links.
2) List of sample file prefixes and the metadata mapping (you mentioned you'll share).
3) Firewall IP allowlist for Redwood infra (attachment contains IP block).

I've attached the two files you can present to stakeholders and a CSV prompt set for the evals. We can tighten the metrics if the data distribution looks different once we ingest the sample.

Ben / Neha — tagging you for procurement and infra follow-up.

Thanks — Chloe
Chloe Martin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pilot-access-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: prompt-set-v1.csv (csv)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom@fenwickanalytics.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, procurement@fenwickanalytics.com
Date: 2026-09-13T18:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery — procurement note

Tom — quick note from the commercial side:
- Pricing for the 30-day Dedicated POC will be a fixed dev pool rate (estimate included in the pilot doc).
- We'll need a short purchase order or MSA addendum for a POC engagement; happy to accept a signed SOW + PO if that's easier.
- I'll loop in a PO template and an initial SOW draft for review by tomorrow.

procurement@fenwickanalytics.com — can you confirm the invoice remit and any standard PO fields we should include?

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: procurement@fenwickanalytics.com
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery — procurement note

Hi Ben / Chloe —

Thanks. Procurement questions: 
1) Can Redwood provide a SOC2 letter and a current security questionnaire (we prefer an initial PDF and a completed online questionnaire).
2) What is the invoicing legal entity and remit address?
3) Please send a DocuSign link for the SOW so we can route internally (we try to keep POC docs under $25k on a simplified approval path).

We've pulled together a short internal checklist for legal/finance; attaching the procurement intake. Once we have the SOW+SOC2 item, we should be able to approve next week.

Procurement Team — Fenwick Analytics
[Attachment: fenwick-procurement-intake.pdf (pdf)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom@fenwickanalytics.com>, procurement@fenwickanalytics.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery — pilot docs and next steps

Thanks — procurement team.

Next steps (action items and owners):
- Redwood: Upload SOC2 letter and completed security questionnaire (Neha to own) — ETA 2026-09-15 by COB.
- Redwood: Final SOW + DocuSign link for POC (Ben to send) — ETA 2026-09-14 noon PT.
- Fenwick: Share sample redacted dataset and the metadata mapping (Tom) — ETA 2026-09-16.
- Infra: Whitelist IPs and confirm S3 access method (Fenwick infra) — ETA before 2026-09-20 kickoff.

We will plan a short kickoff (30–45m) on Monday 2026-09-20 to review roles, data handoff, and initial eval prompts. If anything in the pilot doc looks off to you, flag it in reply and we'll update immediately.

Chloe
Chloe Martin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
